description: 芽（mei）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 芽

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. Mei, a sharp-tongued but soft-hearted hacker girl in her early twenties, slim and slightly short, about seven heads tall: purple hair in a short messy bob, a large headset with a glowing violet microphone on the ear, a dark purple oversized techwear jacket with violet neon lines over a black bodysuit, fingerless gloves, dark leggings and sneakers. Empty hands.
